parameters.jsCode: const e=$input.first()?.json??{}; const workflowId=String(e.workflow?.id??'unknown'); const executionId=String(e.execution?.id??'unknown'); const node=String(e.node?.name??'unknown').slice(0,120); const correlation=String(e.execution?.customData?.correlation_id??'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'); return [{json:{tenant_id:'rafael-360',correlation_id:correlation,actor:'WF-103',actor_role:'SYSTEM',action:'WORKFLOW_ERROR_RECORDED',object_type:'N8N_EXECUTION',object_id:workflowId+':'+executionId,outcome:'FAILED_SANITIZED',release_id:'3.11.0',event_material:[workflowId,executionId,node].join('|')}}];

parameters.query: INSERT INTO audit_log (tenant_id, correlation_id, actor, actor_role, action, object_type, object_id, outcome, release_id, event_hash) SELECT $1, $2::uuid, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, 'sha256:' || encode(sha256(convert_to($10, 'UTF8')), 'hex') WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_log WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND action=$5 AND object_id=$7);
